fullPassage:
Various Volunteer Activities You Might Want to Participate in

Reading Volunteer Work
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.

Longevity Photography Volunteer Work
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.

Various Volunteer Activities You Might Want to Participate in

Reading Volunteer Work
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation. 

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day.
